The background is a clean, off-white wall. (2) He speaks animatedly, wiping his face with a white tissue. Large white captions with black outlines appear at the bottom. (3) He holds up a circular, rose-gold colored cosmetic cushion compact labeled 'SKINTIFIC'. He points to it and smiles broadly. (4) He opens the compact, revealing a round application puff and the foundation inside. (5) On his inner forearm, which has two black band tattoos, he swatches the foundation, demonstrating it covers the tattoo completely. (6) Returning to his face, he continues talking, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his points. (7) He pads the foundation onto his right cheek using the puff in a rhythmic motion. (8) Text bubbles containing various skin concerns pop up around his face as he continues padding the product. (9) He looks closely at the camera, tilting his head to show the finish on one side of his face. (10) A brief black-and-white stylized shot appears with dramatic text. (11) He quickly applies foundation to the other side of his face in a fast-forwarded sequence. (12) He uses a large fluffy brush to apply a translucent powder over the foundation across his face. (13) Finally, he wipes his face with a tissue again to show it's dry, then holds the compact up one last time with a thumbs-up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a quick male vocal exclamation followed by a mid-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track with synthesized drums. A light 'pop' sound effect punctuates the first second. (2) The narrator begins speaking in a high-energy, friendly Mandarin Chinese, emphasizing keywords like 'concealing degree.' (3) The BGM remains steady as the narrator introduces the brand 'SKINTIFIC' with a clear, professional tone. (4) A mechanical clicking sound is heard as the compact opens, followed by a slight rustle of fabric. (5) A sparkling 'whoosh' and 'ding' SFX are used as the narrator demonstrates the product's coverage on his tattoo. (6) The vocal delivery remains fast-paced and enthusiastic. (7) As the narrator pads his face, synchronized rhythmic 'pop' sound effects accompany each visual tap on his skin. (8) A series of digital 'ding' sound effects play in quick succession as labels appear on screen, layering over the BGM. (9) The narrator's voice becomes slightly more intimate and whispery when discussing texture, then returns to full conversational volume. (10) A sudden dramatic minor-key musical sting and a slightly comical vocal delivery play during a stylized segment. (11) During a fast-forward sequence, the narrator's voice is pitch-shifted higher (chipmunk effect) to match the visual speed. (12) A soft 'swoosh' sound of a brush is heard repeatedly as he explains powdering. (13) A crisp paper-like rustle of a tissue is heard as he wipes his face, followed by a final energetic recommendation and a smooth fade-out of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Proof/Demonstration -> Detailed Benefits -> Final Verdict.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote and review the SKINTIFIC cushion foundation. It utilizes a high-energy personal testimonial combined with visual proof (covering a tattoo and facial redness) to demonstrate the product's high coverage and skin-like finish. The fast-paced editing and social-media-native style are designed to engage viewers quickly and maintain interest throughout the product application process.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features the SKINTIFIC product, mentions the brand name multiple times, provides specific shade recommendations, and shows the packaging clearly.
